d: Bihar men lok aastha ke char divsiy mahaparv chhath puja ki taiyariyan pure joron par hain. isi kari men vaishali jile ke hajipur se samaj seva aur paranpra ko jivit rakhne ki ek behad sarahniy tasvir samne aaee hai. yahan aaj ke yuvaon ne apne purvajon ke pharj ko nibhate hue 1051 chhathavratiyon ke bich sanpurn pujan samagri ka vitran kiya hai.
